policy: Preserve original archives and versions. Extract selected bytes only, never execute them. Direct PRX downloads are replacement binaries requiring the matching support files and license; they are not complete installations.

packs.title: Expulsion V5.0 · direct files
packs.license: MIT notice embedded in supplied pack
packs.compatibility: PS4 GoldHEN plugins; GTA V CUSA00419 game update 1.57. V5.0 INSTALL.txt supplies only this title ID.
packs.installation: Merge the complete data and user support trees into /data and /user. Keep the maps directory and existing saves. Merge the exact PRX entry under CUSA00419 in your existing plugins.ini. Direct PRX download alone is appropriate only for a matching installation with its support files already present.

packs.title: Expulsion V7.0 · direct replacement files
packs.license: MIT and Lua MIT notices embedded in supplied pack
packs.compatibility: PS4 GoldHEN plugins; GTA V game update 1.57, CUSA00419 USA or CUSA00411 EUR per INSTALL.txt. The author states EUR hardware testing remains required.
packs.installation: Use the full ZIP for a new installation: merge PS4/data and PS4/user, preserve existing custom files and match the title ID. The direct PRX is a replacement option for a matching installed support tree. The Lua scripts need this Expulsion build and its documented API; desktop Python background tools remain in the original archive and are not console payloads.

officialDirectBins.distribution: Official direct BIN URLs match the archived release byte for byte. No general redistribution license was found; use the author's pinned official URLs as the public direct download and archive locally without claiming an open license.
